일.forms: Sino-Korean · dates, money, minutes, phone numbers, floors (일 층, 일월 일일)
일.e: Also used for phone numbers. 일월 = January. Different from 일 (work).
일.t: Use 일 for dates, money and minutes; use 하나/한 for counting items, people and hours.

일.x: There's a lot of work at the company these days.
일.t: Not to be confused with Sino-Korean 일 'one' (一) or 'day' (日).

내리다.m: to get off (a vehicle); to fall (rain, snow); to go down
내리다.x: I get off at the next station.
내리다.e: Opposite of 타다 (get on). 비가 내리다 = rain falls.
내리다.t: The vehicle takes 에서: 버스에서 내려요.

계시다.m: to be, to stay, to exist (honorific of 있다 for people)
계시다.x: My mother is at home now.
계시다.e: Honorific of 있다 for people; 안녕히 계세요 = Goodbye (to someone staying).
계시다.t: 계시다 is for a respected person's location; 'have' uses 있으시다: 시간 있으세요?

어리다.x: My younger sibling is still young.
어리다.e: For kids: 어린이 = child, and 어린이날 = Children's Day (May 5).
어리다.t: Don't confuse 어려요 (is young) with 어려워요 (is difficult, from 어렵다).

항상.e: Both parts mean 'constant' — doubled up for 'always'.

주사를 맞다.forms: 주사를 맞았어요 (I got a shot) · 주사를 놓다 (to give a shot)
주사를 맞다.m: to get a shot, to get an injection
주사를 맞다.ex: 어제 병원에서 감기 때문에 주사를 맞았어요.
주사를 맞다.x: I got a shot at the hospital yesterday for my cold.
주사를 맞다.e: 맞다 here means 'to receive (be hit by)'; the nurse 놓다, 'puts in', the shot.

비가 오다.forms: 비가 와요 · 비가 왔어요 · 비가 올 거예요
비가 오다.x: It's raining, so be sure to take an umbrella.
비가 오다.e: Literally 'rain comes': Korean weather 'comes' instead of using 'it'.

설거지.ex: 밥을 먹은 후에 제가 설거지를 할게요.
설거지.x: After we eat, I'll do the dishes.
설거지.e: Means the act of washing up, not the dishes themselves; dishes are 그릇.

고등학교.x: I graduated from high school and went to college.
고등학교.t: Korean high school is three years, so 고등학교 1학년 equals American tenth grade.

칼.ex: 부엌에서 칼을 사용할 때는 항상 조심하세요.
칼.x: Always be careful when you use a knife in the kitchen.
칼.e: 칼국수 'knife-cut noodles' is named after it.

데이트.ex: 주말에 여자 친구와 한강에서 데이트를 했어요.
데이트.x: I went on a date with my girlfriend at the Han River on the weekend.
데이트.e: From English 'date'; only the romantic meaning, not a calendar date (날짜).
rel: to date, to go out with

잊다.x: I forgot my friend's birthday and felt really sorry.
잊다.t: 잊다 is forgetting information; losing an object is 잃다 — don't mix them up.

반면에.forms: Sentence start: 반면에 ...; after a verb: -는 반면에
반면에.m: on the other hand, whereas, in contrast
반면에.ex: 형은 조용해요. 반면에 동생은 아주 활발해요.
반면에.x: The older brother is quiet. On the other hand, the younger one is very lively.

혼내다.m: to scold, to tell off, to punish
혼내다.ex: 선생님이 숙제를 안 한 학생을 혼내셨어요.
혼내다.x: The teacher scolded the student who didn't do the homework.
혼내다.e: Probably 혼 'soul' + 내다 'to take out': scaring someone out of their wits.
혼내다.t: 혼내다 = to scold someone; 혼나다 = to get scolded.

살리다.m: to save (a life), revive; to make the most of
살리다.x: The doctor saved the patient who was in danger.
살리다.t: 살려 주세요! is how you shout 'Help!'; 장점을 살리다 means 'make the most of your strengths.'

애쓰다.forms: 애써요 · 애썼어요 · 애쓸 거예요 · 애쓰세요 (ㅡ drops)
애쓰다.m: to try hard, make an effort, strive
애쓰다.ex: 모두 이번 행사를 위해 애써 주셔서 감사합니다.
애쓰다.x: Thank you all for working so hard on this event.
애쓰다.t: 애쓰셨어요 is a warm way to thank someone for their effort.

성향.x: My younger sibling has a quiet, introverted disposition.

합리적.ex: 이 가게는 품질도 좋고 가격도 합리적이에요.
합리적.x: This store has good quality and reasonable prices too.
합리적.t: Pronounced [함니적] — nasalization; 합리적인 가격 is a very common phrase for 'reasonable price'.

사우나.x: After working out, I sweated it out in the sauna.
사우나.t: In Korea 사우나 often means the whole bathhouse, not just the hot room, and many bathhouses have 사우나 in their name.

해수욕장.ex: 여름이 되면 해수욕장에 사람이 정말 많아요.
해수욕장.x: In summer the beaches get really crowded.
해수욕장.t: Pronounced [해수욕짱]: ㅈ becomes tense after ㄱ. Most officially open only in summer, roughly July to August, when lifeguards are on duty.

웬만큼.forms: 웬만큼 + verb/adjective: 웬만큼 하다, 웬만큼 잘하다
웬만큼.m: to a fair degree, reasonably, moderately; enough
웬만큼.x: I speak Korean reasonably well, so traveling is no problem.

미끄러지다.m: to slip, slide; to fail (an exam)
미끄러지다.x: The road was icy, so I slipped in front of my house.
미끄러지다.t: Colloquially, 시험에 미끄러지다 means to fail an exam.

획기적.ex: 스마트폰은 우리 생활에 획기적인 변화를 가져왔어요.
획기적.x: Smartphones brought groundbreaking changes to our lives.
획기적.e: Literally 'dividing the periods'—so big it starts a new era.

힘차다.ex: 새해에는 힘차게 새로운 일을 시작하고 싶어요.
힘차다.x: In the new year, I want to start something new with energy.
힘차다.e: Built from 힘 'strength' + 차다 'to be full': full of strength.

본보기.ex: 형은 동생들에게 좋은 본보기가 되어야 해요.
본보기.x: An older brother should be a good example to his younger siblings.
본보기.e: 본 'model' + native 보기 'something to look at': an example to follow.
본보기.t: Common patterns: 본보기가 되다 = to set an example; 본보기로 삼다 = to take as a model.

공방.m: back-and-forth attack and defense, exchange of attacks
공방.ex: 여야는 예산 문제로 치열한 공방을 벌였습니다.
공방.x: The ruling and opposition parties had a fierce exchange over the budget.
공방.t: Homonym: 공방 (工房) means 'workshop, studio', as in a craft studio.

호기심.x: Kids are very curious about new things.
호기심.e: Literally 'a heart that likes the unusual'.

항쟁.x: In 1980, an uprising for democracy broke out in Gwangju.

급부상하다.m: to rise rapidly, to shoot to prominence
급부상하다.ex: 그 신인 배우는 드라마 한 편으로 스타로 급부상했어요.
급부상하다.x: That new actor shot to stardom with a single drama.

안간힘을 쓰다.forms: 안간힘을 써요 · 안간힘을 썼어요 · ~(으)려고 안간힘을 쓰다
안간힘을 쓰다.m: to try with all one's might, to strain every nerve, to struggle hard
안간힘을 쓰다.x: He tried with all his might to hold back his tears.
안간힘을 쓰다.e: 안간힘 is the strain of holding back pain or breath; 쓰다 here means 'to exert'.

냉소적.ex: 그는 정치에 대해 늘 냉소적인 반응을 보여요.
냉소적.x: He always reacts cynically to politics.

젠트리피케이션.ex: 젠트리피케이션 때문에 오래된 가게들이 동네를 떠나고 있어요.
젠트리피케이션.x: Because of gentrification, long-standing shops are leaving the neighborhood.
젠트리피케이션.e: From English 'gentrification'; in Korea it often means small shops pushed out by rising rents.

독해력.x: If you read the newspaper every day, your reading comprehension improves.
독해력.e: -력 = ability or power: 독해력, 어휘력, 연기력.

틀림없이.ex: 그 사람은 틀림없이 약속 시간에 올 거예요.
틀림없이.e: From 틀리다 (to be wrong) + 없이 (without): 'without being wrong'.
틀림없이.t: Pronounced [틀리멉씨] — the ㅆ sound comes from the ㅄ batchim.

문화 교류.ex: 두 나라는 문화 교류를 통해 더 가까워졌습니다.
문화 교류.x: The two countries grew closer through cultural exchange.

형량.m: length of a sentence, severity of punishment
형량.ex: 피해자 가족은 형량이 너무 가볍다고 반발했습니다.
형량.x: The victim's family protested that the sentence was too light.
형량.t: Pronounced [형냥] — ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅇ.

연립정부.ex: 두 정당이 손을 잡고 연립정부를 구성했습니다.
연립정부.x: Two parties joined hands and formed a coalition government.

범신론.x: Spinoza's philosophy is often interpreted as pantheism.
범신론.e: Literally 'god-in-everything theory': nature itself is divine.

형평.ex: 세금 제도는 형평에 맞게 설계되어야 합니다.
형평.x: The tax system should be designed to be fair.
형평.t: Most often seen as 형평성: 형평성에 어긋나다 (to be unfair).

풍토병.x: Malaria is an endemic disease in some tropical regions.
풍토병.e: Literally 'wind-and-soil disease' — tied to a region's climate and land.
풍토병.t: Pronounced [풍토뼝]; the -병 suffix is usually tensed.

탐사선.ex: 달 탐사선이 달 표면 사진을 보내왔습니다.
탐사선.x: The lunar probe sent back photos of the moon's surface.

문필가.m: writer, man or woman of letters
문필가.ex: 그는 정치인이면서 뛰어난 문필가로도 알려져 있어요.
문필가.x: He is a politician but is also known as an outstanding writer.
문필가.e: Literally 'writing-brush expert'; -가 marks a professional: 작가, 화가, 소설가.

상복.ex: 유족들은 검은 상복을 입고 손님을 맞았어요.
상복.x: The bereaved family wore black mourning clothes and greeted the guests.
상복.e: Literally 'mourning clothes.' Traditionally rough hemp; today usually black.

머금다.m: to hold in the mouth; to hold back (tears); to wear (a faint smile)
머금다.ex: 그녀는 눈물을 머금고 작별 인사를 했어요.
머금다.x: Holding back her tears, she said goodbye.
머금다.e: Something kept inside, neither swallowed nor released — like petals holding dew (이슬을 머금다).
머금다.t: Classic pairs: 미소를 머금다 'to wear a faint smile' and 눈물을 머금다 'to fight back tears'.

태연히.x: He laughed calmly even in a dangerous situation.

지그시.ex: 그는 눈을 지그시 감고 음악을 들었어요.
지그시.x: He gently closed his eyes and listened to the music.
지그시.e: Don't mix up with 지긋이 'maturely, patiently', as in 나이가 지긋하다.
지그시.t: Common collocations: 눈을 지그시 감다, 입술을 지그시 깨물다, 지그시 누르다.

범주화.ex: 사람들은 정보를 범주화해서 기억하는 경향이 있습니다.
범주화.x: People tend to remember information by categorizing it.

서당 개 삼 년이면 풍월을 읊는다.de: 서당 개 삼 년이면 풍월을 읊는다
서당 개 삼 년이면 풍월을 읊는다.rom: seodang gae sam nyeonimyeon pungworeul eumneunda
서당 개 삼 년이면 풍월을 읊는다.pr: 서당 개 삼 녀니면 풍워를 음는다
서당 개 삼 년이면 풍월을 읊는다.forms: 서당 개 삼 년이면 풍월을 읊는다더니 · 서당 개 삼 년이면 풍월을 읊는다고
서당 개 삼 년이면 풍월을 읊는다.m: you pick things up just by being around them long enough (lit. after three years at a village school, even the dog recites poetry)
서당 개 삼 년이면 풍월을 읊는다.ex: 서당 개 삼 년이면 풍월을 읊는다고, 카페 3년 차라 커피 맛을 좀 알아요.
서당 개 삼 년이면 풍월을 읊는다.x: Even the school dog recites poetry after three years: I've worked at a café for three years, so I know a bit about coffee.
서당 개 삼 년이면 풍월을 읊는다.e: A dog living at a 서당 (traditional village school) hears the pupils every day for three years and ends up reciting poetry (풍월, literally 'wind and moon').
서당 개 삼 년이면 풍월을 읊는다.t: Pronounced [서당 개 삼 녀니면 풍워를 음는다]. Often said modestly about skills you picked up just by being around something, without formal training.
